headline: A wall of ice and rock let go above a Nepal river
subheading: The Langtang collapse became a debris flood down the Bhote Koshi-Trishuli corridor, burying towns, farms, and power plants.
image_alt: A wall of ice and rock let go above a Nepal river (watercolor)

headline: Hundreds of millions faced a longer, deadlier heat season
subheading: World Weather Attribution: human-caused warming roughly tripled the odds of this 15-day India-Pakistan heat and made it about 0.9°C hotter.
image_alt: Hundreds of millions faced a longer, deadlier heat season (watercolor)

headline: Western Europe's June nights stopped cooling people down
subheading: World Weather Attribution found heat like this virtually impossible 50 years ago, as fossil-fuel warming rewrote the season.
image_alt: Western Europe's June nights stopped cooling people down (watercolor)

headline: More than 1% of Iberia burned in one fire season
subheading: Spain's worst fires in 30 years, during a record heatwave. Fire weather was about 40 times more likely in today's climate.
image_alt: More than 1% of Iberia burned in one fire season (watercolor)

headline: Reliance says it will plant AI compute on the Gujarat coast
subheading: The company announces 168 MW for Meta plus a 120 MW first phase, with renewables and seawater cooling still unaudited.
image_alt: Reliance says it will plant AI compute on the Gujarat coast (watercolor)

headline: A war inland moved the price of bread on every shelf
subheading: FAO's food price index hit a record annual average. Inflation, rate hikes, and hunger risks followed.
image_alt: A war inland moved the price of bread on every shelf (watercolor)

headline: Bhopal 1984: the gas cleared, the groundwater did not
subheading: 40 years later Amnesty and CGWA/NGT still document toxic waste and contaminated wells.
image_alt: Bhopal 1984: the gas cleared, the groundwater did not (watercolor)

headline: Deepwater Horizon: dolphin lungs still failing 15 years on
subheading: NOAA science: Barataria Bay dolphins down about 45%. Recovery may take about 35 years.
image_alt: Deepwater Horizon: dolphin lungs still failing 15 years on (watercolor)

headline: They turned a sea into a desert that still storms our lungs
subheading: Irrigation emptied the Aral Sea. Decades later UNEP still traces Aral dust plumes hundreds of kilometres away.
image_alt: They turned a sea into a desert that still storms our lungs (watercolor)
